A notable pattern among the missing GET schemas: many of the universe/market/dogma/alliance/war "list all" endpoints return simple `number[]` arrays (lists of IDs). These could all share a trivial `z.array(z.number())` schema. The remainder (like `getMarketGroupInformation`, `getCorporationIcon`, `getCharacterSkills`, etc.) return structured objects that would need dedicated schemas.
